title: 115,255 Cattle Sold on Contract. Only 51,704 Net Bought.

lines.say: Contracts for one hundred fifteen thousand, two hundred fifty-five head of cattle sold. Only fifty-one thousand, seven hundred four net bought. That's the government's chart from the Agridime trial.
lines.show: Contracts for 115,255 head of cattle sold. Only 51,704 net bought. That's the government's chart from the Agridime trial.

scene.label: HEAD SOLD ON CONTRACT|ONLY 51,704 NET BOUGHT

lines.say: Buyers paid two thousand dollars a head, with guaranteed fifteen to twenty percent yearly profits.
lines.show: Buyers paid $2,000 a head, with "guaranteed 15-20% yearly profits."

scene.src: Second Superseding Indictment, U.S. v. Link (N.D. Tex. 2026)

lines.say: Prosecutors say new money paid earlier buyers. The U.S. Attorney called it a high-tech Ponzi scheme.
lines.show: Prosecutors say new money paid earlier buyers. The U.S. Attorney called it a "high-tech Ponzi scheme."

scene.q: the Link brothers ran a high-tech Ponzi scheme

lines.say: On November tenth, the Link brothers were found guilty.
lines.show: On November 10, the Link brothers were found guilty.
